panels.description: Alex removes a corroded cover beneath the misleading gauge. Leave upper machinery space.
The compact brass Measure rests inside; its three arms unfold. Leave upper space for the inscription.
Alex lifts the Measure while Ada watches the engraved collar. Leave upper chamber space.
The instrument rejects the official data line, then locks onto the analog gauge. Leave upper display space.

items.text: WHAT IS NOT MEASURED CAN BE MADE INVISIBLE
